leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the transform-origin property to modify the pivot point of CSS transformations
Configure different transform-origin values (keywords, percentages, length units) for precise control
Manipulate element rotation and scaling by adjusting the transform-origin point
Construct interactive examples that demonstrate how transform-origin affects transformation behavior
Integrate transform-origin with other CSS properties to create coordinated visual effects
Implement responsive transform-origin adjustments that adapt to different screen sizes
Control transformation origins for multiple elements within a single animation sequence
